institutional_scope: U.S. District Court, Middle District of Florida

remedy.notes: The Grievance Committee reported that counsel said he "may have used artificial intelligence to draft the filing(s)". The March 8, 2024 federal Opinion and Order adopted and incorporated that report, found multiple forms of misconduct, imposed federal-bar suspension and conditions, and directed service on the Florida Bar. AI attribution was not determined; the cited sources do not establish that AI caused the fabricated authorities. The federal documents do not establish a separate Florida Supreme Court disposition, later state disciplinary outcome, or current reinstatement/compliance status.
